BIOGRAPHICAL SKETCH

Name	Position Title	Date of Birth
John M. Johnston	Professor of Biochemistry and Obstetrics-Gynecology	11/14/28

EDUCATION:

Institution and Location	Degree	Year Conferred	Field of Study
Hastings College, Hastings, NB	B.A.	1949	Chemistry
Univ. Colorado School of Medicine	Ph.D.	1953	Biochemistry
Medicine, Denver, CO			

RESEARCH AND PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE:

1949 - 1953 Teaching Fellowship, Department of Biochemistry, University of Colorado School of Medicine

1953 - 1955 Research Associate, 1/Lt. Walter Reed Institute of Research, Washington, DC

1955 - 1957 Instructor, Biochemistry, The University of Texas Southwestern Medical Center at Dallas, TX
1957 - 1960 Assistant Professor, Biochemistry, The University of Texas Southwestern Medical Center at Dallas, TX
1960 - 1966 Associate Professor, Biochemistry, The University of Texas Southwestern Medical Center at Dallas, TX
1960 - Present Elected member of Graduate School, The University of Texas Southwestern Medical Center at Dallas, TX
1962 - 1963 Visiting Professor, National Science Foundation Research Fellow, Department of Physiological Chemistry, The University of Lund, Sweden
1966 - Present Professor, Biochemistry, The University of Texas Southwestern Medical Center at Dallas, TX
1967 - 1968 Acting Chairman, Department of Biochemistry, The University of Texas Southwestern Medical School, Dallas, TX
1968 - 1971 Chairman, Graduate Studies Committee in Biochemistry, The University of Texas Southwestern Medical School, Dallas, TX
1973 Visiting Professor, Institut für Medizinische Biochemie der Universität Graz, Austria
1974 - Present Professor, Obstetrics and Gynecology, The University of Texas Southwestern Medical Center at Dallas, TX
1980 - Present Director, Division of Lipid Research, Department of Biochemistry, The University of Texas Southwestern Medical Center at Dallas, TX
1981 - 1985 Interim Chairman, Department of Biochemistry, The University of Texas Southwestern Medical Center at Dallas, TX

AWARDS:

1976 Purdue Frederick Award, The American College of Obstetrics and Gynecologists

1981 - Present Frank C. Erwin, Jr., Professor of Biochemical Obstetrics, The University of Texas Southwestern Medical Center at Dallas, TX (Endowed Chair)

1984 Presidential Award, American Oil Chemist Symposium
1988 Distinguished Alumni Award, Hastings College, Hastings, NB
